text.p: Alternative Resources Corp said Thursday Richard Williams joined the company as president, chief operating officer and a director.
Larry Kane, formerly president, retains his position as chairman and chief executive officer.
Williams, 51, previously was senior vice president at Dun & Bradstreet Corp, where he was in charge of corporate strategy and marketing, as well as chief of technology.

Commenting on Williams' appointment, Kane, said, "We have achieved our goal in finding a proven corporate leader whose entrepreneurial spirit matches our culture, and who can guide this company on its path of reaching more than $500 million in revenues."
Alternative Resources provides technical services, including outsourcing, consulting and project-based resources, for information technology operations of Fortune 1000 and mid-sized companies.
